before: A drawing group with a text box member painted nothing. Under mc:AlternateContent an inline payload that could not paint also took no space on its line.
after: The group paints its picture and shape members. A text box member paints its fill and outline but not its text. An inline mc:AlternateContent payload that cannot paint keeps its extent on its line and paints nothing.
reason: The change is a read-only projection of existing document XML. It adds no shared state, operations, snapshot fields, or protocol messages, and it writes nothing to the document. The mc:AlternateContent wrapper was already one paragraph offset, so paragraph offsets do not change.
